vb_textbox.text: I got advice from a participant saying they checked the house size and beard style and neither were useful.What was useful was looking at the size of the hats- I tended to get a larger amount of the taller hats being bigger payouts at the beginning and end of the game, and the shorter hats in the middle.I stuck with one of the hats until it went down to 3 mushrooms, and then when I switched, the other hat usually gave me a higher amount.
